name: Regional log-coverage cross-attention bias (bv)
plain: Concatenates all regional prompts into one context and adds a per-token logit bias to cross-attention, based on how much of each query token a region covers. Uncovered pairs get minus infinity. Outside the active sigma window the bias stays in force with strength zero, so the regional prompts stay hidden rather than becoming global.
math:
effective(q) = coverage_slot(q)·clamp(slot_strength·strength, 0, 1).
bias(q, tokens of slot) = log(max(effective, 1e-6)) where effective>0, else −∞. Global slot (no mask): 0.
softmax is taken over score + bias through optimized_attention_masked.

props.hook: attn2 replacement calling optimized_attention_masked (SDXL router); other routers per family
props.architectures: SDXL router read. krea2 and anima variants exist.
